description: A pattern bank and two extra controls for Proteus, and it goes immediately to the right of one

params.text: Stores the melody Proteus is playing in slot 1; a slot that already holds one has to be cleared first
Sends the melody stored in slot 1 back to Proteus, where the LENGTH and DENSITY knobs are applied to it
Empties slot 1 so a new melody can be stored there
Stores the melody Proteus is playing in slot 2; a slot that already holds one has to be cleared first
Sends the melody stored in slot 2 back to Proteus, where the LENGTH and DENSITY knobs are applied to it
Empties slot 2 so a new melody can be stored there
Stores the melody Proteus is playing in slot 3; a slot that already holds one has to be cleared first
Sends the melody stored in slot 3 back to Proteus, where the LENGTH and DENSITY knobs are applied to it
Empties slot 3 so a new melody can be stored there
Stores the melody Proteus is playing in slot 4; a slot that already holds one has to be cleared first
Sends the melody stored in slot 4 back to Proteus, where the LENGTH and DENSITY knobs are applied to it
Empties slot 4 so a new melody can be stored there
Stores the melody Proteus is playing in slot 5; a slot that already holds one has to be cleared first
Sends the melody stored in slot 5 back to Proteus, where the LENGTH and DENSITY knobs are applied to it
Empties slot 5 so a new melody can be stored there
Transposes every melody Proteus plays by 0 to 11 semitones
Makes Proteus play 0 to 32 silent beats at the end of each loop

inputs.text: A rising edge past 2V loads the next stored melody in the bank
A rising edge past 2V loads the previous stored melody in the bank
A rising edge past 2V loads one of the stored melodies at random
Adds to the transpose knob, 1V covering all 11 semitones
Adds to the rest knob, 1V covering all 32 beats

notes: this module does nothing on its own; the two knobs and the pattern bank only reach Proteus while one is placed immediately to the left, which the lamp at the top left shows
a stored melody keeps its own notes, so loading one saved in a different scale plays that scale rather than the one Proteus is set to now

inputs.0:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3:
0 to 1V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
inputs.4:
0 to 1V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
